title.zh: 【Zcash 创始人呼吁：终止社区资助后续资金，并设立未来开发与法律辩护基金】
title.en: 【Zcash 创始人呼吁：终止社区资助后续资金，并设立未来开发与法律辩护基金】

current_state.zh: Zcash founder Zooko is urging support for a ZIP proposal by Tachyon Group and Shielded Labs that would terminate follow-on Zcash Community Grants funding, reduce the ZCG treasury, donate $50 million to the Network Sustainability Mechanism, and establish future development and legal defense funds.
